subject: Re: Kickoff: Global MetNet nowcasting as a platform data product
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Milan 50%, Tereza 80%, Wei 40%, Vera 60%. Fine for the 4/15 go/no-go.

Compute: the model was trained on TPUs, so fine-tuning stays on our cirrus-tpu quarterly allocation - I have asked for a quarter-pod slice for three weeks in March. A GPU fallback exists but means shrinking the training example dimensions, which I would rather not do for an eval we intend to publish internally. Inference for the archive rebuild is CPU-heavy, not GPU, so titan is untouched.

Dependency, and the reason Jun is cc'd: the reforecast archive re-ingestion runs through Corpus. Reminder that the Corpus v2 migration freeze lands 2026-07-10, so the reforecast archive re-ingestion has to be requested in Q2 and scheduled well before that date. Tereza will file the ingestion request this week.

Jelena
